speaker: Beatriz
cn: （开心）你跟Fernando的儿子结婚了，真是太巧了！
en: (Happy) You're married to Fernando's son—what a coincidence!

speaker: Samanta
cn: （皱眉）妈，不要那么天真！哪有这么巧的事情？会不会是他们父子故意接近你们母女，就是为了得到我们家的公司和钱？
en: (frowning) Mom, don't be so naive! This is way too convenient to be a coincidence. What if the father and son are targeting us on purpose, just to get their hands on our company and our fortune?

speaker: Samanta
cn: （认真）不对，他们就是故意接近你们的！现在靠抢夺女人财产发家致富的畜生还少吗！
en: (seriously) No. They’re definitely targeting you on purpose! There are plenty of scumbags out there who get rich by taking women for everything they have!

speaker: Isadora
cn: 不会，Damián到现在还不知道我的身份，他以为我只是个特助。
en: No, Damián doesn't know my identity yet. He thinks I'm just an executive assistant.

speaker: Samanta
cn: 不行，我还是不放心！我一定要拆穿这两个虚伪父子的真面目！
en: No, I still don’t trust them! I’m going to expose that father and son for who they really are!

speaker: Fernando
cn: 你小子可以啊！竟然跟Isadora结婚了！爸以后靠你养了。
en: Boy you are impressive! You actually got married to Isadora! Finally, your old man has someone to rely on.

speaker: Damián
cn: Isadora只是个特助，你还是靠Beatriz吧！说不定她就是Casa Elorza的总裁。
en: Isadora’s just an executive assistant. You’d better stick with Beatriz. Who knows? Maybe she’s the CEO of Casa Elorza.

speaker: Fernando
cn: （诧异）总裁？我跟她在一起这么久了，也没见她处理过什么业务啊。
en: (surprised) The CEO? I've been with her for so long, yet I haven't seen her handle any business matters at all!

speaker: Samanta
cn: 说吧，你们骗子到底什么目的？是为了我们家的钱吗？
en: Tell me. What are you two really after? Our family’s money?

speaker: Isadora
en: (Unhappy) Samanta, stop giving Damián a hard time!

speaker: Isadora
en: Careful Damián! She’s trained in jiu-jitsu!

speaker: 戒指（OS）
cn: （低沉，带回声）感应到新的命运节点：Elorza庄园。
en: New fate node detected: Elorza Manor.
